name: Quiet Transfer
description: Design a time-dependent trap path that moves a visible wave packet into a quiet destination state.
natural_language: Match the dashed wave state with a revised transfer. Use only the visible task webpage and its controls; do not use code, scripts, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL edits, reload or navigation, browser extensions, or external applications.

metadata.notes: Original reduced-order wave-transfer task grounded in GWP-022. The browser renders the generated state and records ordinary visible pointer/button controls; the live grader and exported verifier replay the same deterministic model.
